postfx.addEffectHint: Opens the library of available effects
postfx.bypassHint: Hold to see the raw image, changing nothing in the document
postfx.duplicateHint: A second instance of the same effect, right after it
postfx.effect_bloomHint: Spills light around whatever rises above the threshold
postfx.effect_blurHint: Softens the whole image, gaussian or box
postfx.effect_chromaticAberrationHint: Splits the colours the way a lens that does not focus them together does
postfx.effect_colorGradingHint: Exposure, contrast, saturation and temperature, all of the colour in one pass
postfx.effect_crtHint: Curved glass, aperture grille, offset beams and falling corners
postfx.effect_ditherHint: Breaks the banding of a flat area with an ordered pattern
postfx.effect_dofHint: Focuses at one distance and lets the rest fall away
postfx.effect_dotScreenHint: A grid of dots modulated by luminance
postfx.effect_filmGrainHint: The noise of an emulsion, strongest in the mid-tones
postfx.effect_fxaaHint: Smooths edges in one pass, the cheapest of them
postfx.effect_gtaoHint: Darkens creases and contacts, which is what sits objects on the ground
postfx.effect_halftoneHint: The screen of a print, in rotated dots
postfx.effect_lensDistortionHint: Bends the image into a barrel or a pincushion
postfx.effect_lutHint: Applies an imported colour lookup table
postfx.effect_outlineHint: Detects the edges of the image and draws them
postfx.effect_pixelateHint: Reduces the image to square blocks
postfx.effect_posterizeHint: Brings each channel down to a finite number of steps
postfx.effect_rgbShiftHint: Offsets the three channels in one direction
postfx.effect_scanlinesHint: Horizontal lines, counted rather than measured
postfx.effect_sharpenHint: Brings out fine detail through an unsharp mask
postfx.effect_smaaHint: Cleaner edges than FXAA, for a little more
postfx.effect_ssaaHint: Draws the scene several times and averages them, for the cleanest edges
postfx.effect_ssaoHint: The same idea as GTAO, older and coarser, but cheaper
postfx.effect_vhsHint: Bleeding chroma, a wandering line and a head-switching band
postfx.effect_vignetteHint: Darkens the edges and brings the eye back to the centre
postfx.emptyHint: Add an effect or apply a preset to compose this scene
postfx.importFailedShape: This file is not a post-processing composition
postfx.importFailedVersion: This file comes from a newer version of the studio
postfx.inheriting: This camera follows the scene, and the settings below are the scene’s
postfx.mode_disabledHint: The camera renders the scene with no post processing at all
postfx.mode_inheritHint: The camera films through the scene’s composition
postfx.mode_overrideHint: The camera carries its own stack, independent of the scene
postfx.presetDeleteHint: Removes this preset from this machine
postfx.presetExportHint: Writes this composition to a shareable file
postfx.presetHint: Replaces every effect with a ready-made composition. ⌘Z puts it back
postfx.presetImportHint: Reads a composition from a shared file
postfx.presetRenameHint: Changes the name of this preset on this machine
postfx.presetSaveHint: Keeps this composition under a name, on this machine
postfx.skippedHint: Only one effect of this rank is applied, the one placed highest
postfx.title: Post-processing
postfx.toggleEffect: Switch this effect on or off
postfx.unkey: Remove the key on this parameter
postfx.effect_radialBlurHint: Everything smears towards a point — the dash, the hit, the speed
postfx.effect_letterboxHint: Black bars at the aspect a film is framed for
postfx.effect_heatHazeHint: The image wobbles, as over hot air or under water
postfx.effect_kuwaharaHint: Flattens the inside of shapes and keeps their edges, like a painting
